text: I've now been waiting over an hour for a callback so I'm putting it in writing. I'm a childminder, the little boy I have tonight is 3 and has chickenpox, spots all over and itching like mad but otherwise he's absolutely fine in himself. Temp 37.6. No fits, no shaking, nothing like that. Parents asked me to check about the purple marks on his legs. They're felt tip. He drew on himself. They come off with a baby wipe, I've already done one leg. I just need to know if I can give anything for the itching at his age, that's all.
